root = Col([dashboard, Caption("演示数据 · 按参考图复刻；散点为近似值，指标沿用原图独立口径，漏斗条宽仅为示意。")])
$na = true
$eu = true
$asia = true
$stage = ""
dashboard = Box([header, metrics, panels, detail], "col", 3, 3, "#f3f3f3", "xl", false, "100%")
header = Col([Title("Performance overview", "lg", "#151515"), Text("Across all regions in 2025 (YTD), total advertising spend reached $2.4B", "sm", "#737373")], 2)
metrics = Box([Grid(@Each(kpis, "k", Box([Title(k.value, "xl", "#111111"), Text(k.label, "xs", "#777777")], "col", 1, 2)), 4, 130, 3)], "col", 0, 3, "#ffffff", "xl", false, "100%")
kpis = [{value: "$110.42Mn", label: "Total Ad spends"}, {value: "$425.5Mn", label: "Total sales"}, {value: "342%", label: "Average ROI%"}, {value: "12", label: "Active campaigns"}]
panels = Box([scatterPanel, funnelPanel], "row", 3, 0, null, null, false, "100%", null, null, "stretch", "start", true)
scatterPanel = Box([Text("Ad spends vs Sales", "sm", "#171717", "semibold"), plot, legend], "col", 2, 4, "#ffffff", "xl", false, "60%", null, 1.7)
funnelPanel = Box([Text("Campaign funnel", "sm", "#171717", "semibold"), stages], "col", 2, 4, "#ffffff", "xl", false, "35%", null, 1)
plot = Svg([Line(35, 198, 710, 198, "#eeeeee", 1), G(@Each([2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7], "n", SvgText(n + "M", 0, 194 - (n - 2) * 33, 10, "#777777"))), G(@Each(ticks, "t", SvgText(t.label, t.x, 215, 10, "#777777", "middle"))), G(@Each(points, "p", Circle(35 + p.x * 337.5, 194 - (p.na - 2) * 33, 4.8, "#6b55d9")), null, $na ? 1 : 0), G(@Each(points, "p", Circle(8 + p.x * 337.5, 194 - (p.eu - 2) * 33, 4.8, "#9ebbee")), null, $eu ? 1 : 0), G(@Each(points, "p", Circle(-6 + p.x * 337.5, 194 - (p.asia - 2) * 33, 4.8, "#eda83f")), null, $asia ? 1 : 0)], "0 0 720 225", "100%")
ticks = [{x: 35, label: "100K"}, {x: 210, label: "500K"}, {x: 375, label: "1M"}, {x: 545, label: "1.5M"}, {x: 710, label: "2M"}]
points = [{x: 0.2, na: 3.9, eu: 3.15, asia: 2.6}, {x: 0.41, na: 4.35, eu: 3.5, asia: 2.95}, {x: 0.66, na: 4.85, eu: 3.82, asia: 2.82}, {x: 0.91, na: 5.25, eu: 4.25, asia: 3.37}, {x: 1.16, na: 5.7, eu: 4.43, asia: 3.65}, {x: 1.41, na: 6.15, eu: 4.7, asia: 3.48}, {x: 1.66, na: 6.48, eu: 4.88, asia: 4.06}, {x: 1.87, na: 6.8, eu: 5.05, asia: 4.25}]
legend = Row([Pressable([Row([Box([], "col", 0, 0, $na ? "#6b55d9" : "#dddddd", 2, false, 7, 7), Text("North America", "xs", $na ? "#666666" : "#bbbbbb")], 1)], @Set($na, !$na), false, 0), Pressable([Row([Box([], "col", 0, 0, $eu ? "#9ebbee" : "#dddddd", 2, false, 7, 7), Text("Europe", "xs", $eu ? "#666666" : "#bbbbbb")], 1)], @Set($eu, !$eu), false, 0), Pressable([Row([Box([], "col", 0, 0, $asia ? "#eda83f" : "#dddddd", 2, false, 7, 7), Text("Asia", "xs", $asia ? "#666666" : "#bbbbbb")], 1)], @Set($asia, !$asia), false, 0)], 3, "center", "center", true)
funnelData = [{name: "Impressions", value: "4.2M", count: 4200000, width: 270, color: "#533cdd", next: "7.4%"}, {name: "Clicks", value: "310K", count: 310000, width: 142, color: "#7568eb", next: "13.5%"}, {name: "Sign-ups", value: "42K", count: 42000, width: 86, color: "#98b4ef", next: "23.3%"}, {name: "Purchases", value: "9.8K", count: 9800, width: 60, color: "#c9d1f8", next: ""}]
stages = Col(@Each(funnelData, "f", Col([Pressable([Svg([SvgText(f.name, 0, 23, 11, "#777777"), Rect(200 - f.width / 2, 8, f.width, 20, f.color, null, 0, 1, 4), SvgText(f.value, 375, 23, 11, "#202020", "end", "semibold")], "0 0 380 36", "100%")], @Set($stage, $stage == f.name ? "" : f.name), $stage == f.name, 0, null, "sm"), f.next != "" ? Svg([SvgText("↓ " + f.next + " continue", 200, 13, 9, "#777777", "middle")], "0 0 380 24", "100%") : null], 1)), 1)
chosen = @Find(funnelData, "name", "==" == "==" ? $stage : "")
detail = $stage != "" ? Box([Row([Text($stage + " · " + @Format(chosen.count, "number") + "（演示）", "sm", "#343434", "semibold"), Spacer(), IconButton("x", @Set($stage, ""), "收起阶段详情", "ghost")], 2), Text("占初始曝光的 " + @Format(@Percent(chosen.count, 4200000), "percent", 2) + ($stage == "Purchases" ? " · 已到漏斗末端" : " · 下一阶段转化率 " + chosen.next), "sm", "#777777"), Link("查看阶段报告 ↗（占位链接：example.com）", "https://example.com")], "col", 2, 3, "#ffffff", "lg", false, "100%") : null
